subject: Temporary retention window & evidence handoff for backup purge
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@medica-analytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Medica Legal Team <legal@medica-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary retention request for upcoming audit — backup purge timeline?

Hi Ava,

Thanks for picking this up. We have a regulatory audit kickoff on 2028-07-10 and compliance has asked us to collect evidence that Redwood's backups covering our account (Medica Analytics) will not be purged during the audit window. Specifically they want:

- The backup purge schedule for the next 90 days
- A signed acknowledgement of any temporary retain/hold windows
- A list of artifacts you can provide (snapshots, immutable IDs, restore manifests, audit logs) and their expected delivery format

Can you confirm whether Redwood can place a temporary 45-day retain on the relevant backup sets for Medica (or suggest an alternative), and what evidence you can hand off? If there are DPA/DPA-amendment steps needed to support this work, please flag them.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Senior Compliance Manager
Medica Analytics
[Attachment: medica_audit_request_form.pdf]
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@medica-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary retention request for upcoming audit — backup purge timeline?

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear asks.

Short answer: we can implement a temporary retain and provide a focused evidence package; below is a proposed operational plan for your review. If Medica needs a contractual amendment to the DPA to formalize a temporary retain, we'll start the DocuSign flow once you confirm approvers.

Proposed plan (operational):
- Retain window: 2028-06-20 to 2028-08-03 (45 days) applied to Medica backup sets in EU region
- Purge freeze: block automatic purge jobs targeting Medica snapshot tags during the window
- Evidence deliverables: immutable snapshot IDs (CSV), restore manifest, ingestion timestamps, short-term audit logs (token-level redacted)
- Delivery cadence: evidence package delivered within 3 business days of window start; follow-up handoff call if Medica Legal requests format changes

Open questions / constraints for Medica Legal:
- Do you need log retention beyond 45 days (you mentioned 90 days in the request)? If so we need to discuss an exception for log TTLs because long log retention impacts cost and retention policy globally.
- Who should sign the DPA amendment? Please send the DocuSign recipient + email.

I've attached a runbook stub that describes the steps our SREs will run and the export formats. If this works, Kimberly/Legal and I will prepare the DPA amendment and DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: proposed-temporary-retain-runbook.pdf

Best,
Ava Chen
Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary retention request for upcoming audit — backup purge timeline? (internal)

Ava / team — quick internal note before we send anything formal to Medica Legal.

1) Evidence scope: compliance typically asks for:
   - Snapshot IDs + creation timestamps (CSV)
   - Object manifests with checksums (when available)
   - A short statement on retention controls and who ran the hold (ops user + ticket id)
   - Redacted access logs for the snapshot retrieval (if they request logs we need to ensure PII is redacted)

2) Log TTL exception: we usually cap syslog/audit log retention at 30 days in EU by default; we can grant an exception to 90 days but need Finance confirmation on the incremental cost. 

3) DPA amendment: small addendum is fine (one-page). Priyom, can you draft a minimal amendment that references a temporary retain window, list the metadata artifacts, and includes a termination clause if the audit is canceled?

I exported a raw CSV of sample immutable IDs for the last two snapshots — I'll sanitize and attach medica_evidence_manifest.csv to the outgoing message once Ava gives the green light.

-Kim
Legal Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@medica-analytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Medica Legal Team <legal@medica-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary retention request for upcoming audit — backup purge timeline?

Thanks, Ava — that plan looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications: 

- Medica would ideally like log retention extended to 90 days for this engagement (audit team requirement). If Redwood can accommodate that via an exception, we will accept the 45-day snapshot retain plus 90-day logs.
- DocuSign approver: I can receive the DPA amendment (marta.lopez@medica-analytics.com) and Legal will co-sign (legal@medica-analytics.com).

Please send the DocuSign link and the evidence manifest when ready. Once Legal signs we will notify you and we can kick the window on 2028-06-20 as proposed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Marta
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@medica-analytics.com>, Medica Legal Team <legal@medica-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary retention request for upcoming audit — backup purge timeline?

Marta / Legal — confirming next steps and delivering artifacts.

1) DPA amendment: Kimberly and Priyom prepared a one-page addendum to authorize the temporary retain and extended log TTL. DocuSign envelope sent to Marta (link below).
2) Evidence: attached medica_evidence_manifest.csv (immutable snapshot IDs + timestamp + checksum) and a short runbook describing how we implemented the hold.
3) Operational timeline: kick the hold on 2028-06-20 00:00 UTC; scheduled automatic lift on 2028-08-03 23:59 UTC unless DocuSign or Legal requests an earlier release.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/rs=docsign/abc123
Drive handoff: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/retention/medica-evidence

Attachments: medica_evidence_manifest.csv, proposed-temporary-retain-runbook.pdf, docsign_dpa_amendment_link.txt

If Medica needs any additional artifact types (e.g., full restore verification), let us know before 2028-06-18 so we can schedule the extra work.

Thanks — Ava
